headline: Gazipur youth sent to jail under Anti-Terrorism Act for social media post
summary: Sifat Abdullah, a 20-year-old student, was detained after posting a video complaining about electricity bills that allegedly contained abusive remarks about the PM.
details: A Gazipur court has sent 20-year-old Sifat Abdullah to jail in a case filed under the Anti-Terrorism Act. The youth was detained by police from the Gachha area of Gazipur City Corporation.
The case stems from a Facebook video where Sifat complained about his household electricity bills, claiming he was overcharged by Tk 4,000 one month and Tk 5,000 the previous month.
According to police, the video also contained abusive remarks about Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and individuals associated with the government.
Sifat, a student of Adamjee Cantonment College, was produced before the court today after being detained yesterday evening.

The arrest has drawn criticism from Ali Naser Khan, chief organiser of the NCP central executive committee, who noted that Sifat had also criticised several political parties, including the NCP and BNP.
Ali Naser Khan urged authorities to release the youth, warning that the issue could become an international concern if not resolved.
caption:

The arrest has drawn criticism from Ali Naser Khan, chief organiser of the NCP central executive committee, who noted that Sifat had also criticised several political parties, including the NCP and BNP.

headline_marked: Woman [[dies after being hit by SUV]] carrying State Minister
headline: Woman dies after being hit by SUV carrying State Minister
summary: A 70-year-old woman was killed in Bogura after a collision involving the vehicle of State Minister Abdul Bari.
details: A 70-year-old woman, identified as Firoza Begum, died after being hit by an SUV carrying State Minister for Public Administration and Food Abdul Bari and his wife in Bogura’s Shibganj upazila.
Police reported that the SUV swerved off the Bogura-Joypurhat road and fell into a paddy field while attempting to avoid hitting the woman.
The incident occurred around 9:00 am in the Gopinathpur area while the state minister was traveling from Dhaka to Joypurhat.
Firoza Begum was rushed to Bogura’s TMSS Medical College and Rafatullah Community Hospital, where she passed away during treatment at approximately 11:00 am.
State Minister Abdul Bari sustained an injury to his right leg during the accident.
Following the incident, the state minister was initially taken to Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital in Bogura before being transferred to Square Hospital in Dhaka for advanced treatment.
Shibganj Police Station has recorded a general diary (GD) regarding the accident.
The Shibganj Upazila administration has provided Tk 25,000 in financial assistance to the victim's family for burial expenses.
caption:
A 70-year-old woman has died after being hit by a State Minister's SUV in Bogura.

A 70-year-old woman, identified as Firoza Begum, died after being hit by an SUV carrying State Minister for Public Administration and Food Abdul Bari and his wife in Bogura’s Shibganj upazila.

Police reported that the SUV swerved off the Bogura-Joypurhat road and fell into a paddy field while attempting to avoid hitting the woman.

The incident occurred around 9:00 am in the Gopinathpur area while the state minister was traveling from Dhaka to Joypurhat.

Firoza Begum was rushed to Bogura’s TMSS Medical College and Rafatullah Community Hospital, where she passed away during treatment at approximately 11:00 am.

State Minister Abdul Bari sustained an injury to his right leg during the accident.

Following the incident, the state minister was initially taken to Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital in Bogura before being transferred to Square Hospital in Dhaka for advanced treatment.

Shibganj Police Station has recorded a general diary (GD) regarding the accident.

The Shibganj Upazila administration has provided Tk 25,000 in financial assistance to the victim's family for burial expenses.
